description: This source file implements the RedisGatewayListProvider class, which provides gateway list information for Orleans clustering using Redis as the backend. It interacts with a Redis-based membership table to retrieve active silo addresses and exposes methods for initializing the provider and fetching gateway URIs.

classes.name: RedisGatewayListProvider
classes.description: A provider class for retrieving gateway addresses from Redis-backed membership table, implementing IGatewayListProvider interface.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Fetches the list of active gateway URIs from Redis membership table.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the Redis membership table for the gateway list provider.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed staleness period for the gateway list.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Indicates whether the provider's list can be updated dynamically.
